The apprentice mage is a 2nd level spellcaster. Their spellcasting ability is Intelligence (spell save DC 12 +4 to hit with spell attacks). They have the following wizard spells prepared:

- **Cantrips** (at will): Fire Bolt, Light, Prestidigitation
- **1st-Level** (3 slots): Detect Magic, Magic Missile, Shield
